scope.summary: Aggregate closure for 14.10: assert every design-system panel/picker/inspector/visible state is headlessly inspectable, steerable, and screenshot-capturable through Argus with no foreground focus steal, and ships dual-audience UserManual entries (operator layer + model layer: command ids, typed I/O, receipts, undo semantics, Argus targets, failure/recovery) kept same-change current. This MT verifies coverage completeness across all design-system operator-surface MTs (MT-323..MT-365) rather than authoring a new feature.
acceptance_criteria: all 14.10 surfaces Argus-inspectable + dual-audience manual complete; coverage-completeness proven; no focus steal
proof_targets: Argus coverage audit + manual self-consistency test
expected_tests: argus: every design-system operator surface inspectable + screenshot-capturable with no focus steal
HBR-MAN-003 self-consistency: every design-system command_id has a dual-audience manual entry
test: Argus target registry covers all studio.design_system.* surfaces

risk_if_missed: Design-system surfaces not fully Argus/manual-covered; no-context models cannot discover or verify them.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
